mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 36 degrees under clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a waning crescent moon overhead.

The Verona Plan Commission is holding a meeting on December 7th to discuss several development projects, including the site plan, survey map, and lighting plans for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, residents are encouraged to stay updated on city programs by subscribing to the official digital newsletter.

We have a great lineup of local entertainment. Live Music at Bailey's Run is happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly look at noteworthy calls, police reported that on October 25th, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
It is going to be a sweet day. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, and you can stop by to enjoy the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day.
